exposure: conception method (spontaneous, ovulation induction/intrauterine insemination (OI/IUI), in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI))
outcome: second-trimester uterine artery Doppler pulsatility index (UtA-PI)
cohort: The study included 15,552 singleton pregnancies presenting for routine antenatal care, including a second-trimester anomaly scan.
finding: IVF/ICSI conception was independently associated with significantly lower second-trimester uterine artery pulsatility index values compared to spontaneous conception and OI/IUI pregnancies, while no significant difference was observed between spontaneous conception and OI/IUI groups.
gest_age: Second trimester (at the time of scan)
